en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand spa town. In the foreground stands a large neoclassical Kurhaus building with arched windows and balustraded terraces. A riverside promenade is crowded with pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing, and horse‑drawn carriages move along the street beside a canal or small river. Behind are more ornate multi‑storey spa and hotel buildings, with wooded hills rising in the background. Red printed captions at the top name the place and buildings.
